methods.summary: Reads a contract's read-only functions from a handler, with typed results.
methods.description:
Reads a contract's read-only functions from a handler, with typed results.

Pass `ctx`, the contract id and its ABI. Every call is pinned to the block
being processed. Set `options.cache` to `"contract-constant"` to fetch a
value once per contract instead of once per block.

types.name: ChainReadCacheMode
types.summary: How long a read stays valid.

types.name: ChainReadError
types.summary: A handler asked for something no node can answer: a function missing from the ABI, or one that isn't read-only.

types.name: ChainReadMethods
types.summary: The camelCased read methods of an ABI.
types.definition: { [N in ExtractReadOnlyFunctions<C> as ToCamelCase<N>]: ChainReadMethod< ExtractFunctionArgs<C, N>, Promise<UnwrapResponse<ExtractFunctionOutput<C, N>>> >; }

types.name: ChainReadOptions
types.summary: Options for a contract read, such as cache mode.

fields.name: contract
fields.type: (contractId: string, abi: unknown, options?: ChainReadOptions) => { read: Record<string, (args?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<unknown>> }
fields.description:
Reads a contract's read-only functions at the block being processed.

Results are untyped here. Call it through `readContractAt` to get typed
results from the contract's ABI.
